Synopsis:
Yorkville America, the ETF firm behind Trump's Truth Social-branded funds, is nearing completion of an acquisition of an institutional SMA (separately managed accounts) firm, expected to close in September. Concurrently, it is launching the MANGOS Plus Index ETF — tracking Meta, Anthropic, Nvidia, Alphabet, OpenAI, SpaceX, plus AI-adjacent names like Micron and SanDisk — using perpetual futures for pre-IPO exposure to Anthropic and OpenAI. This marks Yorkville's first ETF outside the Truth Social brand and the debut of its digital/crypto product category. A further ~12 ETF filings are in the pipeline across digital economy and macro strategies.
